title: Nine Minutes On A Floor We Don't Have

scenes.text: HE CLIMBED TO A FLOOR WE DON'T HAVE
scenes.narration: The stairwell camera on three shows a man climbing past at two in the morning. The camera on five never sees him arrive.
scenes.imagePrompt: A concrete stairwell at night with a painted number 3 on the wall, a man in a dark coat climbing the next flight, seen from behind, no face visible, seen from a high corner security camera, wide-angle lens distortion, soft low-resolution video texture, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.text: THERE IS NOTHING BETWEEN THREE AND FIVE
scenes.narration: Nine minutes later he comes back down past three. There is nothing between three and five. This building has no fourth floor.
